title: Adaptation and Prescription-Change Guarantee Terms by Northgate Optical Lens Design
content:
These terms set, for each Northgate Optical lens design, the length of the non-adapt guarantee, how many free non-adapt remakes a job receives, whether a non-adapt remake may move the job to another lens design, and the length and count of the free prescription-change remake.

| Lens design | Non-adapt window (calendar days after dispensing) | Free non-adapt remakes per job | Non-adapt remake may switch design | Prescription-change remake window (calendar days) | Free prescription-change remakes per job |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 0 (no non-adapt guarantee) | 0 | no | 60 | 1 |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 30 | 1 | yes | 60 | 1 |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 30 | 1 | yes | 60 | 1 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 60 | 1 | yes | 60 | 1 |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 90 | 2 | yes | 90 | 1 |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 90 | 2 | yes | 90 | 1 |

## Terms explained

1. **Non-adapt window.** The number of calendar days after the dispensed date during which a patient who cannot adapt to the lens design receives a free remake. A window of 0 means the design carries no non-adapt guarantee: Northgate Single Vision Lenses have none.
2. **Free non-adapt remakes.** The most non-adapt remakes a single job receives free of charge.
3. **Design switch.** Where marked yes, a non-adapt remake may move the job to another lens design.
4. **Prescription-change window and count.** The length in calendar days of the free prescription-change remake window, and the number of free prescription-change remakes a job receives: one on every design.

## Comparing designs

- The three lined and standard designs differ only in the non-adapt window: 30 days for Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses and Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses, 60 days for Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses, each with one free non-adapt remake and a 60-day prescription-change window.
- Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses and Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses carry the longest terms: a 90-day non-adapt window with two free non-adapt remakes, and a 90-day prescription-change window.
